description: WP-G3 Codex: Orks (11e) GET OUT DA WAY! (Nobz) through the real charge UI. Fixture ork11e_g3_charge: Witchseekers C (INFANTRY) stand 2.2" in front of Nobz A, Custodian Guard B 7" away behind them. Real clicks: the Nobz in the charge unit list, Custodian Guard B in the target list, Declare Charge, Roll 2D6 (seeded 9+), Snap to Contact, Confirm Charge Moves. The snapped lanes run THROUGH the Witchseekers' bases (11e 03 forbids that to other units — the same ChargePhase / ChargeController gate refuses it for them, and for the Nobz through a MONSTER/VEHICLE model); the phase accepts the move: the Nobz end engaged with Custodian Guard B and clear of the Witchseekers.
